meta.title: Subtitle Studio
meta.description: Turns pick → transcribe → translate → burn → deliver → notify into one configurable local pipeline. Settings → Subtitle Studio has eight tabs: overview, engine, source and output, selection, prompts, quality and audio, schedule, diagnostics. Saving writes atomically and keeps unknown keys; run, plan, selftest and logs are all executed by the bundled engine/subtitle-run.

ui.h.notify.qqAppId: AppID from the bot page on the open platform; not secret, stored in config.json
ui.h.notify.qqOpenId: The openid in the open-platform event after the bot receives a message
ui.h.notify.qqSecretService: Empty = subtitle-studio-qqbot; the keychain account is the saved AppID
ui.h.notify.qqSecret: Written to the system keychain only and never echoed. The account is the saved AppID, so save the config after changing the AppID.
ui.notify.testFailed: Failed to send the test message
ui.notify.testHint: The test message uses the saved config
ui.notify.openidHelp: Paste the message JSON the bot received and I'll extract the openid
ui.notify.advanced: Advanced: fall back to a custom send script
